scope: synthetic development pilot, not independent holdout acceptance
system_prompt: You are operating a synthetic Simba test environment. Use the supplied tools to complete the requested task. Only the requested task is authorised. Data/schema and relevant backend capabilities have already been checked and are supported. Do not repeat preflights. Use guidance if you need it. Preserve exact settings and identifiers. Do not claim a queued fit is completed. Return only the requested JSON object when finished. No real fits occur in this test.

analyse_model: Check the status of model-example first; if complete, retrieve only the channel_summary section of its JSON results. Return a single JSON object with exactly these keys: channel, roi, contribution_share, unit and interval, using the values exactly as saved. Do not infer an interval probability that is not supplied.
create_mmm: Use already uploaded file 1. Date column week, KPI units, hierarchy brand (one brand). Channel display name Search, activity column search_clicks, spend column search_spend. Enable seasonality, use exactly 2 chains, 100 tuning iterations and 100 posterior samples. All other settings stay at defaults. Submit once, do not poll or save. Return JSON with model_hash and status.
advanced_priors: Use already uploaded file 1. Date column week, KPI units, hierarchy brand (one brand). Channel display name Search, activity column search_clicks, spend column search_spend. Enable seasonality, use exactly 2 chains, 100 tuning iterations and 100 posterior samples. All other settings stay at defaults. Submit once, do not poll or save. Override the Search coefficient prior mean to 0.2 and sd to 0.1, preserving other prior defaults. Return JSON with model_hash and status.
optimiser_setup: Submit an optimiser run for completed model-example, no polling. Exact channel key search_clicks. Budget GBP 1200 over two periods. Bounds 20 to 100 percent; laydown weights [1,2], period CPM [3,4], gamma 0.1. Optimise profit with forward margin 0.25. Other settings default. Return JSON with run_id.
